note: Two grouped rowless BF16 projections share a computed vector and retain their output epilogues. A unit matrix row lets both channels use the native MMA schedule while the leading column coordinate stays a group.

attrs.body:
for a0 in 0..4:
    for a1 in 0..16:
        for a2 in 0..256:
            in0 = load v[a0, a2, a1]
            in1 = load w[a0, a2, a1]
            in2 = load x[a2]
            bf16 v0 = negative(in2)
            v1 = multiply(in1, v0)
            acc0 <- add(acc0, v1) over a2
            v2 = multiply(in0, v0)
            acc1 <- add(acc1, v2) over a2
        bf16 v3 = copy(acc0)
        bf16 v4 = copy(acc1)
        bf16 v5 = relu(v3)
        bf16 v6 = relu(v4)
        relu[a0, a1] = v5
        relu_1[a0, a1] = v6
